recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If the work group specifically wants duplicate exposure from the Bundle examples page, handle it as a separate publisher/build-scope follow-up so the prior build-fix rationale can be addressed safely.
issue_request: FHIR-49459 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-I clarification asking for an example Subscription notification payload bundle, noting that the reporter did not find one on either the Subscription or Bundle pages.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir#3967. Commit 8ffdc2266a40417b484fa8d25f8ea59589fcd630 added subscription-notification entries to source/bundle/list-Bundle-examples.xml, but the same PR's later TC build-fix commit e47a0d90025e09296463f865b48705dafca9681b commented that Bundle example-list block out and changed the references back to SubscriptionStatus examples. Earlier source history had already added the actual notification Bundle example files and SubscriptionStatus example-list entries.
additional_context: Subscription and SubscriptionStatus are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current Subscription notes page has a Notification Content section with direct links to empty, id-only, and full-resource notification Bundle examples and the REST Hook section says the server POSTs a notification Bundle to the endpoint. The underlying examples are Bundle resources in source/subscriptionstatus and are listed by the active SubscriptionStatus examples list. FHIR-I WGM minutes record the FHIR-49459 vote as 7-0-1, and Zulip exact-key search found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Re-enabling the commented Bundle example-list block would undo a Jira-PR build-fix commit without evidence that the publisher/build issue has been resolved, while the requested examples remain available from active Subscription and SubscriptionStatus source.

related_jiras.note: Applied Subscription notification-content clarification in the same PR family; it reinforces the current Subscription payload guidance but is a separate tracker and was not decided here.
